verdict.rationale: RudderStack's warehouse/reverse-ETL sources can sync historical data from a warehouse or data lake to newly added destinations, which offers a backfill-like capability, but there is no explicit documentation of an event-replay or reprocessing feature for archived raw events when a pipeline breaks. missing for 10: dedicated event-replay/reprocessing tooling, explicit backfill workflow documentation, and evidence of replaying failed/archived events into destinations after outages.
